legacy_entries.rationale: Explicit synchronization and provenance are shared through tools::drc after #408, but general source authority and the outcome-envelope migration remain incomplete.
legacy_entries.removal_criteria: One owned DRC execution/result contract identifies source state and reports unavailable or partial evidence without ambiguity.

legacy_entries.rationale: The plugin startup path can substitute defaults after an explicitly requested configuration fails, obscuring the refusal from the caller.
legacy_entries.removal_criteria: Explicit-config failure is a structured startup refusal, no substituted defaults are started, and regression coverage exercises the plugin entry point.
